name: SpaceLean
description: SpaceLean is an AI-powered construction planning and 4D scheduling platform that automatically extracts BIM elements (IFC, Revit) and converts them into buildable, sequenced construction schedules in under 90 seconds.
capabilities: Automatic BIM to 4D Gantt Schedule Conversion (IFC / Revit)
AI-driven task planning and duration estimation
Spatial zone mapping to work packages
Lookahead planning and automated delay risk forecasting
Integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Google Calendar, and Zapier

pricing.free_tier: Free forever for individuals and small teams up to 3 members
pricing.paid_tier: Scalable per-seat pricing with SSO, audit logs, and enterprise support
